column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key for engagement records (e.g., 'ENG001').
An enum (InteractionFrequency_enum) for how often interactions occur (Weekly, Monthly, Occasional, Daily).
An enum (PeakActivityTime_enum) describing the highest activity period (Afternoon, Evening, Night, Morning).
A SMALLINT number of days per week the fan is active (e.g., 5).
A SMALLINT average number of sessions per day/week (e.g., 3).
An enum (ContentPreference_enum) capturing the fan's preferred content (Music, Dance, Gaming, Chat).
An enum (ContentLanguagePreference_enum) for content language (Both, Original, Translated).
An enum (TranslationUsage_enum) describing translation usage (Always, Sometimes, Never).
